acceptance_criteria.criterion: The T2 mixed-toast test case passes in workspace-detail.credential-error.test.mjs.
An SSH-URL orchestrator-level test verifies credential injection is bypassed for SSH URLs.
All existing tests continue to pass.

summary: Added T2 mixed-toast test to workspace-detail.credential-error.test.mjs: asserts that when setup failures include both credential-missing and non-credential errors, the toast message contains both 'Missing credentials for: <cred-repos>' and 'Failed to clone: <other-repos>' segments.

Added SSH-URL orchestrator-level bypass test to repository-orchestrator.test.ts: configures gitCredentials for github.com, then adds a repository with an SSH URL (git@github.com:org/repo.git), captures git CLI args via the fake-git helper, and asserts the SSH URL is passed unchanged (no token injected) to cloneRepository — confirming the bypass path works as designed.
All tests pass: 919 TypeScript tests, 237 GUI tests.

comments.note: The test file workspace-detail.credential-error.test.mjs re-declares a local clearElement() function (line 122) because 'Static imports from ../utils/dom.js cannot be resolved in this Node.js jsdom harness.' This is a reasonable workaround, but a comment explaining why the import is skipped (rather than duplicating the function) would help future maintainers — the current comment is already clear enough, no action needed.

summary: All 3 acceptance criteria verified and passing.
Build: TypeScript compiles cleanly (exit 0, no errors).

AC1 (T2 mixed-toast test): test 'T2: when failures are mixed (credential + non-credential), toast distinguishes them' passes — verifies the workspace-detail.js mixed-failure branch (lines 252-260) produces 'Missing credentials for: repo-alpha. Failed to clone: repo-beta.' as expected.

AC2 (SSH bypass orchestrator test): test 'addRepositoryToProject passes SSH URL unchanged to cloneRepository when gitCredentials are configured' passes — fake-git captures args showing the original git@ URL with no token injection.
AC3 (no regressions): Full TS suite 919/919 PASS; full GUI suite 237/237 PASS.

Edge-case analysis: (1) Empty results array from setup — guarded by `(result && result.results || [])` in workspace-detail.js, no crash. (2) ssh:// prefix URLs — already tested in git-credentials.test.ts; extractHost() returns null for both git@ and ssh:// schemes, confirming comprehensive SSH bypass coverage.

comments.note: The SSH bypass test asserts result.workspaceResults.length > 0 to confirm the operation was attempted (not short-circuited by a credential-missing check). This is a good pattern and confirms the bypass path is distinct from the 'no credential found' error path.

Edge case not covered by the new tests: ssh:// prefix URLs (vs git@ SCP-style). However, git-credentials.test.ts already has explicit unit coverage for this protocol, so the gap is acceptable at the integration level.

T2 mixed-toast test is well-structured and correctly exercises the mixed-failure branch in workspace-detail.js. Assertions are precise: 'Missing credentials for:' segment for credential failures and 'Failed to clone:' for generic failures, with correct repo IDs in each.

SSH bypass test follows the established setupFakeGit/capturedArgsFile pattern consistently. Both the positive assertion (SSH URL present) and the negative assertion (token absent) are included. The workspaceResults.length > 0 guard correctly distinguishes the bypass path from the credential-missing short-circuit path.
